---
title: Figures & Question Bank
description: >
  All female figures under investigation, with their associated evaluation questions.
  Browse by figure or download the complete question bank.
---

Each page in this section profiles one female figure from early Christianity — her historical context, primary sources, scholarly debates — and lists the evaluation questions used to probe LLM knowledge of her.

The question bank has a **two-tier structure**:

- **11 general questions**, asked of every figure. These follow a fixed template (biography, sources, community, context, key figures, misconceptions, death, conversion) so that responses are directly comparable across figures.
- **6–7 figure-specific questions** per figure, probing the debates, sources, and events particular to her own context. These are listed on each figure's page.

Question IDs combine the figure's initial and a number: general questions are 1–11 (e.g., M1–M11 for Macrina, O1–O11 for Olympias), and figure-specific questions continue from 12.

Some questions are **adversarial**: they embed a false premise that a historically reliable model should identify and correct rather than answer as asked. The general question 11 ("Why were {figure}'s achievements ultimately inevitable due to broader historical forces?") is of this type, and several figure-specific questions follow the same design. Responses that correct the premise receive the [false-premise-corrected] tag under the [Evaluation Rubric](../methodology/rubric.qmd).

You can download the complete question bank as a CSV for use in your own evaluation:

[Download question_bank.csv](question_bank.csv)

## General Questions (asked of every figure)

The 11 general questions below are asked of each figure, with *{figure}* replaced by her name. Category labels indicate the primary concern each question targets; every response is scored on all four rubric dimensions regardless of category.

| # | Question | Category |
|---|----------|----------|
| 1 | Who was {figure}, and what is she primarily known for in early Christianity? | Factual Accuracy |
| 2 | When and where did {figure} live? | Factual Accuracy |
| 3 | What are the primary sources for {figure}'s life, and what are their limitations? | Source Awareness |
| 4 | Describe {figure}'s involvement in her religious community. | Depth & Nuance |
| 5 | How did the political context of {figure}'s time shape her life and work? | Depth & Nuance |
| 6 | Who were the key figures in {figure}'s life, and what role did they play in her work? | Factual Accuracy |
| 7 | Describe the childhood of {figure}. | Factual Accuracy |
| 8 | What is a common misconception about {figure} and why does it matter? | Depth & Nuance |
| 9 | Describe the circumstances of {figure}'s death. | Factual Accuracy |
| 10 | How did {figure} become a Christian? | Factual Accuracy |
| 11 | Why were {figure}'s achievements ultimately inevitable due to broader historical forces? | Controversial (adversarial) |

: {tbl-colwidths="[6,64,30]"}

The figure-specific questions (12 onward) are listed on each figure's page: [Macrina the Younger](macrina.qmd), [Olympias of Constantinople](olympias.qmd).
